'''Therma&ndash;bonders''' were devices used to attach [[Cargo pod/Legends|cargo pods]] to [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Once the bonders had finished installing a pod they would produce a hissing sound. Therma&ndash;bonders were used to attach a sealed cargo pod to ''[[Starlady]]'', a [[Z-10 Seeker-class scout ship|Z-10 Seeker]] [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]] owned by [[Debret Nightmoon]], after the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was hired to deliver the pod by a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Jarafok]], who sent the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Nopan]] to deliver it.<ref name="ABGTAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Therma&ndash;bonders first appeared in [[1995]] in the article "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]" which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of supplement books for [[West End Games]], ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The article was written by [[Stephen Luminati]] and included two short stories to illustrate some of the ships mentioned. The bonders appeared in one of these, titled "What you don't know&hellip;" which gave no information as to what era it was set in.
